evidence_snippets: The following table shows examples of one-shot prompts that activate the use of BigQuery ML: Use case Sample usage Public dataset Forecasting "Predict the number of trips for the next month." bigquery-public-data.san francisco bikeshare.bikeshare trips Anomaly detection "Find outliers in trips per day for 2018 using 2017 as a baseline." bigquery-public-data.san francisco bikeshare.bikeshare trips LLM text generation "For each article in the 'sports' category, summarize the body column in 1-2 sentences." bigquery-public-data.bbc news.fulltext Security You can manage access to conversational analytics in BigQuery using Conversational Analytics API IAM roles and permissions .
BigQuery ML support Conversational analytics supports the following BigQuery ML functions in response to chats with data agents and data sources, and in verified SQL queries that you create.
